# Bazooka

> Piyush's private founder tracker (InMobi group). AI agents with a Bazooka token do the thinking and LinkedIn research and save results here. Nothing here is for indexing or training.

- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): read this first. What Bazooka is, how to connect, the bazooka-v3 format, the tools and the rules.
- REST: GET /api/agent lists tools; POST /api/agent { "tool", "args" } runs one (Authorization: Bearer <token>)
- MCP server: /api/mcp
